Subject: New vendor request: Shoreline Robotics - legal & remit info

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking the meeting earlier this week. Can you help get Shoreline Robotics added to Redwood's vendor registry so we can start routing POs and invoices? Below is the canonical information we use for onboarding. I've attached a completed W-9 and a copy of our business license.

Company (legal): Shoreline Robotics, Inc.
DBA: Shoreline
Tax ID / EIN: 98-7654321
Remit address (invoicing): 210 Harbor Way, Suite 300
City: Southport
State: CA
ZIP: 94022
Country: USA
Primary AP contact (invoices): billing@shoreline.io
PO contact (purchase orders): elena@shoreline.io
Preferred PO prefix: SHORE-
Payment terms: Net 30 (standard)
Preferred invoice delivery: SFTP (sftp.shoreline.io, acct: redwood_shoreline) or email to billing@shoreline.io
Banking details and ACH will be provided in a separate secure upload if required.

Let me know if you need additional fields (beneficial owner, registered agent, KYC docs). We can also accept Redwood's supplier portal invitation if that speeds things up.

Best,
Elena
Director of Finance
Shoreline Robotics

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor request: Shoreline Robotics - legal & remit info

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Looping in Karthik (Procurement) and Marissa (AP) to confirm a couple of operational details before I push this into the vendor master: 

1) Can you confirm the legal formation date and registered agent (we only need the agent name + mailing address for our records)?
2) For the SFTP delivery: does Shoreline support per-invoice reference metadata (PO number, Redwood vendor ID placeholder) in the file name? Our AP workflow expects invoice files like SHORE-INV_<<PO>>_YYYYMMDD.pdf.
3) Any preferred remit contact for ACH enrollment? If you prefer to provide bank details via our secure portal, we can send the link.
4) Do you accept partial shipments and partial invoice reconciliations against a single PO? (This affects how we set up PO line acceptance.)

If Karthik and Marissa don't flag anything, I'll provision the vendor record and assign a Redwood vendor id. Target: vendor in the registry and portal invite sent today so Ops can issue the first PO.

Thanks — Vivek
Senior Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Vivek — answers inline below. Thanks for the checklist.

1) Legal formation: 2018-04-23. Registered agent: West Coast Corporate Services, 420 Seaport Ln, San Mateo, CA 94401.
2) Yes — we can include PO in file names. We'll follow your suggested pattern. Example: SHORE-INV_PO12345_20250815.pdf
3) ACH contact: payments@shoreline.io — we'll upload bank details to the secure portal. If you send the portal invite to payments@shoreline.io, we'll complete the enrollment today.
4) Partial shipments: yes, we support partial receipts against a PO; invoices will include the PO line-level references.

I've re-attached the W-9 and business license for convenience. Let us know when the portal invite goes out.

Best,
Elena
